_about: Owner-authorized promo Shorts (2026-11-25): one ad image per Short, uploaded by promo_queue.py every 12 h, private or unlisted only. Posts upload in the order listed; ids are permanent (never renumber, never reuse). Add new posts at the end with the next id.

video._audio_note: null = silent stereo track. The YouTube Data API cannot attach YouTube's own or trending Shorts sounds; add one in the YouTube mobile app if you want it. A file here must be listed in assets/music/provenance.json with commercial_use_confirmed and platforms_confirmed including youtube.
